recommendations.description: Consider rotating API keys periodically as a security best practice
Monitor API key usage for any unusual activity
Ensure API keys are stored securely and not exposed in client-side code
Supabase may have cached user data - consider clearing any application-level caches
Postmark suppressions have been cleaned - no further action needed

security_notes: All API keys are system-level keys, not tied to individual user accounts
Supabase keys provide access to the entire database and auth system
Postmark server token provides access to email sending for the entire server
Paystack keys provide access to payment processing for the entire application
